title: AP Police SI and Constable 2026: apply 27 Nov to 16 Dec

scenes.h: AP Police SI & Constable jobs · apply now
scenes.say: Andhra Pradesh Police jobs are open! Three hundred and seventy eight S I posts, and over eight hundred constable posts, plus firemen and jail warders. Apply from the twenty seventh of November to the sixteenth of December.
scenes.sub: Andhra Pradesh Police jobs are open! 378 SI posts, and over 800 constable posts, plus firemen and jail warders. Apply from 27 November to 16 December.

scenes.say: For Sub Inspector, you need any degree. Age twenty one to twenty seven, as on the first of July twenty twenty six. S C, S T, B C and E W S get five years more. The fee is six hundred rupees, and three hundred for S C and S T.
scenes.sub: For Sub-Inspector, you need any degree. Age 21 to 27, as on 1 July 2026. SC, ST, BC and EWS get 5 years more. The fee is ₹600, and ₹300 for SC and ST.

scenes.say: For constable, fireman and jail warder, you need Intermediate. Constables must be eighteen to twenty four, and firemen and warders eighteen to thirty two. The fee is three hundred rupees, and one hundred and fifty for S C and S T.
scenes.sub: For constable, fireman and jail warder, you need Intermediate. Constables must be 18 to 24, and firemen and warders 18 to 32. The fee is ₹300, and ₹150 for SC and ST.

items: Online: 27 Nov, 5 PM to 16 Dec, 5 PM
Then height, running test and final exam
scenes.say: Apply online from five P M on the twenty seventh of November, until five P M on the sixteenth of December. The constable prelims are on the thirty first of January, and the S I prelims on the twenty eighth of February. Then come the height and running tests, and the final exam.
scenes.sub: Apply online from 5 PM on 27 November, until 5 PM on 16 December. The constable prelims are on 31 January, and the SI prelims on 28 February. Then come the height and running tests, and the final exam.

scenes.say: Read the official notification, linked in the description, before you apply. Subscribe to Marg Disha for daily job updates.
scenes.sub: Read the official notification, linked in the description, before you apply. Subscribe to MargDisha for daily job updates.
